text:
The cost to produce one jar is  

- Passion fruit: \(2\text{ lb} \times \$6/\text{lb}= \$12\)  
- Jackfruit: \(1.5\text{ lb} \times \$8/\text{lb}= \$12\)  
- Honey: \(2\text{ lb} \times \$10/\text{lb}= \$20\)

Total cost per jar = \$12 + \$12 + \$20 = **\$44**.  

Selling price per jar = \$50, so profit per jar = \$50 – \$44 = **\$6**.  

For 10 jars, total profit = 10 × \$6 = **\$60**.

**Final answer: 60**
